title: Structure-Preserving Quantum Circuit Architectures for Robot Kinematics
description:
arXiv:2609.16089v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Structured spatial data require quantum encodings that preserve geometric relations, expose measurable observables, and remain implementable on finite-depth hardware. This work introduces a quantum representation and circuit architecture for rigid-body transformations and specializes it to Denavit--Hartenberg kinematics of serial open-chain manipulators. Each translational contribution is factorized into a classical metric magnitude and a signed u
